Commentary.Commentary: Is the score chaseable? There are no pointers that suggest otherwise. Some change of pace should aid the Indian seamers. Can India defend this? Will South Africa chase what's in front of them successfully? Join us in a while as we find out just that.

India got off to a flier, in spite of losing Rohit Sharma and Suresh Raina inside the Powerplay. Both of them scored freely before unwanted shots consumed them. Shikhar Dhawan, though, had different plans. His cuts, pulls, flicks and drives, all came off the middle of the bat and he looked set to notch up a triple figure score before a shot that he'd look at later, consumed him. Virat Kohli looked good for the brief time he was in the middle. But Manish Pandey then played a sensible role in the middle and held the innings together to aid India breach the 200 mark. Of course, the drops from the South African fielders helped India's cause as well.

Excellent comeback from South Africa. They have just conceded 46 in the last five overs. Till the 15th over, India has threatened to get much more than what they have got. But the home side pacers decided to prevent the later damage. After going for 31 off his first two overs, Dane Paterson recovered well to concede just 17 off his last two, getting his yorkers with supreme accuracy. He remained wicketless but the same cannot be said about the debutant Junior Dala. The youngster bowled with a spring in his steps and got a couple of scalps to his name. Tabraiz Shamsi would be cherishing the evening for having got the big scalp of Virat Kohli.

Excellent over from Paterson. He has just conceded 9 off this one. Yorkers fired in with pinpoint accuracy. Pandya only manages to dig it out through backward square leg for a single. 204 IS SOUTH AFRICA'S TARGET!
Fuller outside off, driven straight to long off for one.

SAFE! Full on the stumps, Pandey can only squeeze it towards long on. Takes on the fielder's arms as he returns for the second. Klaasen takes the throw and disturbs the stumps. Looks very excited and the appeal is taken upstairs. One look by the third umpire is enough to press the green light. Two runs added to the tally.
Pandey seems to be a goner. At least that's what Klaasen's reaction suggests. The run out appeal is taken upstairs.
Full on off, smashed back to the bowler. Paterson fails to stop it cleanly and the ball rolls to the off side. A run taken.
Excellent running. Yorker on the stumps, Pandya digs it out towards long on and always wants two. Gets it easily. The throw to the keeper was a good one, right on top of the stumps.
WIDE! Slower ball on a shorter length. Pandya stands tall and looks to flat-bat it straight but misses. Wide signaled for height.
On a length around off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Manish drives it to long on for one.
Full outside off, driven through covers for one.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries from Pandya. Mr. Sher, our colleague here, just asked as to why Pandya wasn't sent ahead of Dhoni today. This delivery adds weight to that question. Very low full toss on the pads, Pandya clips it past short fine leg and gets a boundary.
FOUR! Short in length, Pandya stands tall and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. The transfer of weight on the back foot was wonderful.
Very full outside off, Pandya fails to squeeze it out.
WIDE! This is hurled down the leg side, Hardik fails to flick.
Hardik Pandya is next in.

OUT! Castled! Morris gets the better of his ex-Chennai skipper. Dhoni walks across to flick this one through the on side to target the short boundary. Seeing this Morris spears in a full toss on leg. MS fails to get bat to that as the ball dips and the ball hits the leg stump very low. That's all that Chris and South Africa require.
Hurled on the pads, Dhoni flicks it towards fine leg. He runs the first one hard but doesn't get an opportunity for the second.
Yorker on off, Pandey squeezes it out to the off side and gets to the other end.
Full and outside off, Pandey makes room to play it through the off side but misses.
Short in length, pulled to fine leg for one.

FOUR! I'm loving it! There is a mini banter going on next to me regarding MS's usefulness to the T20 side and with every shot the man in question plays, the bantering sides have points against each other. This is bowled full on off, Dhoni charges down and blasts it straight back past the bowler for a boundary. The pro-Dhoni group gets a point of argument to silence the opposing one, saying look at this bullet-like shot and that should be enough. On having another look, it is seen that it was the cutter.
On a length outside off, Manish stays back and glides it to third man for a single.
Dane Patterson is back on.

FOUR! Remember World T20, 2016? It was the time when Dhoni and Kohli were both masters of playing this shot. Full outside off, Dhoni stays back and slices it just past backward point for a boundary. There was a man running to his right from third man but he had no chance of getting anywhere near.
Fuller on middle, driven down to long on for one.
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side, MP misses the flick.
On a length around middle and leg, flicked off the pads for one.

DROPPED! Another chance goes down. Tabraiz Shamsi is the man who is at fault. This is hurled full on leg, Pandey gets across and looks to get it over short fine leg. Doesn't get the elevation and hits it towards short fine leg. Shamsi gets low to his right and gets both his hands to that but fails to hang on. A run taken. Pandey is a good end-overs batter and hence this could prove costly for the Proteas.
Length ball slanting in, Dhoni pats it to the on side and gets to the other end.
Full outside off, Dhoni clears his front leg and looks to go big over the off side but ends up slicing it over point. Gets two runs as a result.
Chris Morris is back.
Flatter delivery on a length just outside off. Pandey hangs his bat to guide it towards short third man. Wanted a run but is sent back by Dhoni.
Looped up on the stumps, Manish gets it off the inner half towards the bowler.
WIDE! Served around leg, the ball spins further down leg. Pandey gets inside the line and lets it be.
Tossed up on the stumps, Pandey works it away through square leg for a brace.
Floated around off, driven down to long off for one.
Similar delivery, Dhoni looks to punch it off the back foot but gets a thick outside edge straight to short third man.
Flatter outside off, Pandey guides it past short third man. Three runs taken.
Tabraiz Shamsi to bowl out.
Shortish outside off, Pandey guides it past backward point to retain strike.
Dhoni gets off the mark with a push through mid on.
MS Dhoni walks in at number 6 for India, replacing Dhawan.

OUT! Dhawan throws it away! Not a great shot to be honest but credit to the bowler as well. Shikhar gets down early to play the paddle sweep. Spotting this Phehlukwayo delivers a back of the hand slower ball around leg. The southpaw continues with his shot and all he manages is to offer a catch to Klaasen. He dives forward and pouches it safely. End of a scintillating knock from the Indian opener. Can this be the opening for South Africa?

FOUR! There are only fours and sixes today, quips Harsha Bhogle on air, looking at the 16 fours and 7 sixes on show so far. This is short but on the stumps. Dhawan is standing outside the line of leg stump and hence the room that is needed is already available for him. Thrashes it through point and gets a boundary.
WIDE! Andile errs. Bowls it full down the leg side, Dhawan misses the sweep.
Very full on the stumps, Shikhar looks to whip it away but gets it off the inner half to the bowler.
Full outside off, Pandey digs it out towards point and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Short in length, pulled with disdain through square leg for a boundary. 11 off this over, Dala finishes with 4-0-47-2 on debut.

Close! Back of a length ball around off, Pandey hops and hits it to mid on. It's straight to Behardien there. Manish decides to take his arm on. He makes it in as the bowler collects the throw and disturbs the stumps. What's more creditable from Pandey is that he was on the back foot as he played it. Hence he had to cover a yard extra which he did successfully.
Short in length, pulled through backward square leg for one.

FOUR! Is Chris Gayle in to Shikhar Dhawan? Woah! That swag. Fuller in length just outside off, Dhawan gets down on one knee and fetches this from outside off. Hits it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary. Moves to 63 off 34.
Short in length on the body, Manish pulls it to fine leg for one.
Length ball outside off, defended with a straight bat to the off side.
Junior Dala is back on. He'll bowl out now. 3-0-36-2 are his current figures.
Back of a length ball angling in, Pandey hangs back and ramps it towards third man for one.
Nudged through mid-wicket for one.

Good running again. Dhawan just pushes it through mid-wicket and sets off for a run. Seeing the fielder not get to the ball quickly, Pandey calls his partner for the second and both of them reach their ends safely.
Down the leg side, Dhawan looks to sweep but gets it off the thigh pads towards the keeper. Klaasen fails to get down in time and lets it through him. A couple of leg byes result.
FOUR! Shot. Dhawan comes down the track to this one and flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full outside off, driven to covers.
Andile Phehlukwayo is introduced to the bowling crease.
Flatter on off and middle, defended from the crease.

UMPIRE'S CALL SAVES PANDEY! This one is floated around middle, Pandey fails to read the spin in and misses  to get bat. Gets hit on the front pad and that's enough for Shamsi to run in celebration. On not getting the umpire's nod, he starts to appeal rigorously, though it doesn't change the umpire's decision. After some chat with the keeper, Duminy signals for the DRS. Hawk Eye shows that it would have clipped the top of leg. Hence, the on-field call stays although South Africa retain their review.
Another one for Shamsi? Looks to be so. An appeal for LBW against Pandey is ruled not out. But the Proteas have a chat and signal for the DRS. Doesn't look as close as the Kohli one.
Flatter outside off, cut away for a single.

FOUR! 4th T20I fifty for Shikhar Dhawan. He has been confident today and has been middling the shots well and does so yet again. Goes back to this short one and pulls it over mid-wicket for a one-bounce boundary.
Floated outside off, pushed through covers for one.

SIX! Risky shot, pays off this time. Tossed up outside off, Pandey takes him on and lofts it over long off. Just clears a leaping Reeza Hendricks at that position and gets a maximum. Reeza might just be wishing he'd been a couple of foot taller.
Floated around off, driven to long on for on.
Punched off the back foot through covers for one.
Lovely running. Dhawan slinks down the track and pushes it through mid-wicket with soft hands, allowing him to come back for two.
Flicked in front of square on the leg side to rotate strike.
Tossed up on off, driven back to the bowler.
Floated around off, tapped to the on side for one.
Tossed up outside off, driven down to long off by Dhawan and he will keep strike.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Pandey gets going with a flick through mid-wicket.
Manish Pandey is in next, replacing Kohli.

OUT! Dead duck and Kohli walks back taking the review! Looked out to the naked eye and he fails to make his dropped chance count. More than anyone, Farhaan Behardien will breathe a sigh of relief! Tabraiz sends it quicker through the air, lands it around middle and it turns in to ping Kohli on the back pad right in front of the stumps. The bowler keeps appealing and finally gets a positive nod from the umpire. He starts to run with his arms outstretched but Kohli challenges the decision. Hawk Eye shows it's pitched in line and would have hit the stumps. Big wicket for South Africa, can they put a lid on the scoring rate?
A huge, huge appeal and the umpire rules Kohli out after a long thought. Looks a dead duck does Virat, he however, takes the DRS.
Tossed up delivery around middle and off, swept off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Opens the face of the and dabs it with soft hands towards short third man for one.
Gets forward and across and nudged it through square leg to keep strike.
Darted on middle, wristed away towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Bad ball and gets the treatment! Smuts drops it short, gives enough time for the southpaw to go back and pummel it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter ball outside off, Dhawan tries to hit it hard through point but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
VK eases the full ball down to long on to get a single. Also, the 100 is raised for India!
50-run stand is up between the two. Shortish around off, Dhawan hits it wide of long on. The man in the deep fumbles but they don't take another.
Jon-Jon Smuts is brought into the attack now.
Dhawan punches it down to long on to pick 14 from Shamsi's first over.
Goes back to a flatter delivery and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Ahhhh, pure, pure timing, says Gavaskar on air. Flighted ball around middle and off, Kohli dances down the track and chips it straight back down the ground. Meets the sweet portion and clears the fence with so much ease. And immediately the camera is panned on Behardien. How costly will that dropped catch hurt SA?
Around middle and leg, whipped away through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Adding salt to the injury! Shortish delivery, outside off, Kohli rocks back and flays it through point for a boundary.

In the air... Kohli holes out. Scratch that, Behardien drops a dolly! Dear me! You can't drop him! Shamsi could have had struck on the very first ball. Floated delivery on middle and leg, Kohli lofts it down the ground but the bat seems to have turned on the impact. Mistimes it towards long on and gets a life. He doesn't even run.
Tabraiz Shamsi is brought into the attack.
FOUR! Shot! Morris angles it away on a shorter length outside off, Dhawan cuts it behind point to find the fence and spoil a good over.
Fuller ball on off, Dhawan looks to drive but gets it off the toe-end of the bat to mid off.
On a length and some zip off the surface, Virat slices it over point for a single.
Stays back footed to another short ball and punches it towards the man at cover.
Shortish delivery on off, punched nicely only to find the man at cover.
Wide! Morris slips one down the leg side, Kohli tries clipping it away but fails to do so.
On a length and outside off, tapped towards point where Miller makes a good stop.
FOUR! 78 runs from the Powerplay! This is some start for the Indians! Shortish ball with a lot of room on offer, Dhawan slaps it through point to move into the 30s. 18 have come from this over.
Wide! Shortish ball, kicking off the surface, Dhawan just lets it sail over him to the keeper.
SIX! After top edging a couple in the previous over, Dhawan gets one off the meat! Lifts one leg up to a short ball on leg and pulls it with disdain over fine leg for a maximum. Huge one!
Gets across and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Drills it through cover for a single.

Chance of a run out! Back of a length delivery outside off, VK taps it towards cover-point and sets off. Miller gets to the ball and fires a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Had it hit, things would have been interesting.
FOUR! Delightful. Dala hurls this fuller outside off, Kohli reaches out to it and drives it through covers for a boundary. Runs continue to flow for India.

FOUR! Another edge and it goes past the keeper. Dhawan is riding his luck at the moment! Another short ball down the leg side, Dhawan looks to play the natraja pull but gets it off the gloves past the keeper for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Top edge again and more runs! Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Dhawan looks to pull but gets a top edge which flies down to fine leg for a boundary.
Taps this length delivery towards point and calls through for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, Kohli leans ahead and drives it through the gap at cover for a brace. Brings up the 50 for India!
Touch fuller outside off, pushed off the front foot towards the cover fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Chris Morris is into the attack as well.
Virat Kohli is the new man in.

OUT! Top edge and it's wicket no. 2 for Dala! He is roaring in delight! Bowls a length delivery outside off, Raina looks to swipe it across the line but gets a big top edge which balloons high up in the air. Junior Dala calls for it and takes it comfortably. Not a good show on your comeback.
FOUR! Good shot! Raina makes room, Dala fires it full outside off, Suresh crouches low, opens the bat face and lifts it over backward point to find the fence.
Clipped off the hips towards square leg.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Was there an edge? There was certainly a noise. Good length delivery on leg, Dhawan looks to pull but it goes off something to the keeper who takes it and appeals. Nothing from the umpire and instead he calls it a wide. Replays later on show that it has brushed his glove. Reprieve for Dhawan!
Makes room to cut but gets a bottom edge on the bounce to the keeper.
SIX! Whipped away! Fuller delivery on the pads, Dhawan heaves it powerfully over deep square leg for a maximum.

FOUR! In the air... dropped! A tough chance but hello? What is Raina upto? He just got a biggie and tries to get some more. Dances down the track to a length ball and looks to go big. Gets a top edge and it goes high up in the air over mid off. Behardien runs backward, stretches both his arms to take it but fails to hold on. The ball bursts out of his hands and trickles away to the fence.
SIX! Typical Raina shot! Back of a length delivery, following the batsman, Raina stays leg side and pulls it over mid-wicket. Doesn't seem to have middled it but has enough to clear the fence.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Tucks a length delivery towards square leg and gets off the mark.
Hits it hard towards backward point where Shamzi makes a partial stop. A single taken.
Short and slanting away outside off, Dhawan makes room to cut it away but fails to get any wood on it.
Stabs a length ball towards the off side. A successful over for the rookie.
Wide! Fuller in length but strangled down the leg side, Raina misses his flick.
Okay then, Suresh Raina walks in next at no. 3.

OUT! The on-field call is overturned! Maiden wicket for Dala and look at the excitement. Simply superb! He digs in a short ball, gets it to bounce a touch extra. Rohit backs away to ramp it over the keeper but seems to have gotten an edge en route to Klaasen. South Africa put in a huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Heinrich is confident and he convinces his skipper to take the review. Replays roll in and there is a spike on the Ultra Edge. That is it then.
Has Dala struck? Rohit Sharma seems to have edged one to the keeper. However, the bowler shows no interest but the keeper does. Klaasen asks Duminy to take the review...
Another one on a length, just around middle and off, blocked towards cover.
Hangs back to a length delivery and shows a straight bat.
FOUR! Thrashed away! On a back of a length in the channel outside off, Rohit Sharma hits it between cover and point. It was in the air but through the gap as well.
Dhawan wrists it away through mid-wicket to bring Rohit back on strike.
Junior Dala, the debutant to share the new ball from the other end.

FOUR! Up and over! Rohit Sharma moves to 17 in just 5 balls! Another short ball, served outside off, slapped over backward point for a one-bounce boundary. Paterson goes for 18 in the first over of the match.

SIX! Boom! This is turning out to be a huge over! Short ball, doesn't have enough venom behind it. Sharma pulls it neatly and sends it soaring over the fine leg fence for the second maximum of the over.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Dhawan lifts his one leg up and pulls it through backward square leg for a single to open his account.
Inside edge! Brings it back in from outside off, Sharma tries to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge past the leg stump towards fine leg for a single.

SIX! Crashed it! Rohit Sharma is up and running! Receives a short ball, wider outside off, he stands put and throws the kitchen sink at it. Gets it over backward point and it sails over the rope. Quick hands! India are away as well.
Paterson starts off from over the wicket and hurls a length delivery outside off, Rohit Sharma stays back and defends.

Time for the national anthems. It is India's first followed by South Africa's. After the completion we are all set to get underway. The umpires and the players make their way out to the middle. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan will open the batting. Dane Paterson will start off with the bowling proceedings. He has two slips in place. Let's play...

Virat Kohli, Indian skipper says even they wanted to bowl first. Adds it looks a dry surface and feels the batters will enjoy. Informs Suresh Raina, Jaydev Undakat, Manish Pandey and Bhuvneshwar Kumar are in the side. Reckons you can't let the intensity drop and so far it has worked well for them. Opines the atmosphere in the dressing room is really good and the guys are looking forward to do well.

JP Duminy, South African skipper says they are going to bowl first. States it is easier to chase in a day game here. Informs they are without AB de Villiers today as he injured his knee during the last ODI. States the guys are up for the contest and they have included Heinrich Klaasen and Junior Dala (debutants) in the team.
TOSS - Duminy flips the coin and it comes down in his favour. South Africa put India in to bat!

PITCH REPORT - Shaun Pollock says there is a cloud cover over head. Adds it looks a good batting surface and expects the ball to come onto the bat nicely. Calls it a belter of a wicket and informs there is a short boundary on one side of the ground to make matters worse for the bowlers. Reckons he can't find anything on it for the bowlers, no lateral movement and nothing off the pitch either.

A depleted South Africa would take this series as a mark of redemption. JP Duminy will be leading the side and they have called in some fresh faces as the key players haven't recovered from the injuries as yet. To top that list, AB de Villiers has been recently added to that unwanted list. Whether he plays today or not remains to be seen. It's a bit gloomy out there and all we can hope is that the rain stays away. Toss and teams coming up in just a bit...

The Test series and the ODI series is done and dusted. South Africa and India will now lock horns for a 3-match T20I series and we welcome you for our coverage. Virat Kohli and his men have dominated the colored clothing to hand a serious drubbing to the hosts by beating them 5-1. Don't be surprised if you get to see more of that in the shortest format of the game. Suresh Raina, the T20 veteran is called back in the side after quite a hiatus and is expected to be in the starting XI.
